scripts.prebuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'), cp=require('child_process'); const r=cp.execSync('go env GOROOT').toString().trim(); const p=[path.join(r,'lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js'), path.join(r,'misc/wasm/wasm_exec.js')].find(fs.existsSync); if(!p){ console.error('wasm_exec.js not found in GOROOT: '+r); process.exit(1); } fs.mkdirSync('src/vendor',{recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(p,'src/vendor/wasm_exec.js');"
